name: toReal_le_of_le_ofReal
statement: ℝ≥0∞} {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (h : a ≤ ENNReal.ofReal b) : ENNReal.toReal a ≤ b

name: trichotomy₂
statement: ℝ≥0∞} (hpq : p ≤ q) : p = 0 ∧ q = 0 ∨ p = 0 ∧ q = ∞ ∨ p = 0 ∧ 0 < q.toReal ∨ p = ∞ ∧ q = ∞ ∨ 0 < p.toReal ∧ q = ∞ ∨ 0 < p.toReal ∧ 0 < q.toReal ∧ p.toReal ≤ q.toReal
